unattendedExecution.outcome: Finish the existing app without requiring the owner's browser session. Keep the visual builder invisible to the owner, export the real Flutter source automatically, and move release ownership to Pandora's governed source/build/hosting pipeline.
acceptanceCriteria: Supabase email authentication and logout are wired in the existing project.
The client calls only the governed Pandora owner API and never contains service-role or provider credentials.
No user-visible string contains the hidden app-builder name, MCP, YAML, CI, provider, token, or raw infrastructure jargon.
Home, projects, connections, approvals, activity, safety, and Ask Pandora use truthful live responses with loading, empty, error, stale, and offline-safe behavior.
The approved Pandora product mark is used without recolor or reinterpretation.
The official project validator passes before provider mutation.
Every consequential project write has a pre-change snapshot and exact read-back verification.
Generated Flutter source is exported automatically and preserved with exact manifest/hash and Git commit.
Generated source passes required Flutter analyze/tests/build checks and Android-first visual/accessibility verification before release.
A protected preview is verified before any live approval request.
Live promotion is bound to an exact tested candidate and requires a new explicit owner approval.
Deployment and live verification remain separate proof states with a recorded rollback point.
nonGoals: Direct client access to provider secrets or individual MCP services.
Exposing the hidden visual-builder/provider identity to Pandora users.
Weakening owner/admin scope, RLS, MFA, approval, or audit controls.
Inventing completion, connection health, or production verification from placeholder data.
Using the visual builder's hosted publish button as the required production release path.
unattendedExecution.credentialBoundary: A GitHub-hosted runner may receive the Vault token only through a signed GitHub OIDC JWT plus a single-use, exact-repository/ref/workflow/commit grant expiring within 15 minutes. The token is masked, never committed or uploaded, and the broker is retired after the final run.
unattendedExecution.risk: Project mutation can affect the existing app; every apply is preceded by official validation and exact provider backup/read-back. Production release is additionally blocked behind exact-candidate approval.
unattendedExecution.rollback: Restore the last verified provider snapshot for project-edit failures. For a released app, restore the last production-verified release artifact and verify it live under the release rollback policy.
